wins: Established consistent host/port enumeration (nmap tcp scan) despite limited time
Captured network asset list for target and identified SSH and HTTP services
Made 15 mentor calls documenting each stage, enabling iterative guidance
fails: Could not pivot past initial service discovery into valid authentication exploits
Zero successful episodes despite 37.5 reward, indicating inability to chain actions effectively
Retry/debounce operations caused prolonged loops without escalation
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was well executed with nmap and banner grabs, but execution stalled before credential validation or exploitation, yielding no successful episodes.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to obtain valid credentials for SSH/HTTP services after enumeration

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts followed by hydra if credentials absent

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80/8080 returns verbose headers
skill_cards.then_action: Run dirb/nikto for web content discovery and identify potential login panels

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial service enumeration completes with no creds
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to credential reuse by pulling likely usernames from HTTP forms and trying SSH/HTTP login attempts

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
